different_participants.name: different_participants
different_participants.value: "matches"."participant1_id" IS NULL OR "matches"."participant2_id" IS NULL OR "matches"."participant1_id" <> "matches"."participant2_id"

ads_date_valid.name: ads_date_valid
ads_date_valid.value: "advertisements"."start_date" IS NULL OR "advertisements"."end_date" IS NULL OR "advertisements"."start_date" < "advertisements"."end_date"

tournament_sponsors_display_window_valid.name: tournament_sponsors_display_window_valid
tournament_sponsors_display_window_valid.value: "tournament_sponsors"."start_at" IS NULL OR "tournament_sponsors"."end_at" IS NULL OR "tournament_sponsors"."start_at" <= "tournament_sponsors"."end_at"

admin_elo_operations_scope_valid.name: admin_elo_operations_scope_valid
admin_elo_operations_scope_valid.value: ("admin_elo_operations"."scope" = 'PUBLIC' and "admin_elo_operations"."community_id" is null) or ("admin_elo_operations"."scope" = 'COMMUNITY' and "admin_elo_operations"."community_id" is not null)

admin_elo_operations_elo_non_negative.name: admin_elo_operations_elo_non_negative
admin_elo_operations_elo_non_negative.value: ("admin_elo_operations"."previous_elo" is null or "admin_elo_operations"."previous_elo" >= 0) and ("admin_elo_operations"."new_elo" is null or "admin_elo_operations"."new_elo" >= 0)

admin_elo_operations_requested_value_val.name: admin_elo_operations_requested_value_valid
admin_elo_operations_requested_value_val.value: ( "admin_elo_operations"."operation" in ('ADD', 'SUBTRACT', 'SET') and "admin_elo_operations"."requested_value" > 0 and "admin_elo_operations"."requested_value" <= 10000 ) or ( "admin_elo_operations"."operation" in ('RESET', 'HIDE', 'BAN', 'RESTORE') and "admin_elo_operations"."requested_value" is null )

admin_elo_operations_status_valid.name: admin_elo_operations_status_valid
admin_elo_operations_status_valid.value: ("admin_elo_operations"."previous_status" is null or "admin_elo_operations"."previous_status" in ('VISIBLE', 'HIDDEN', 'BANNED')) and ("admin_elo_operations"."new_status" is null or "admin_elo_operations"."new_status" in ('VISIBLE', 'HIDDEN', 'BANNED'))

ranking_context_status_scope_valid.name: ranking_context_status_scope_valid
ranking_context_status_scope_valid.value: ("ranking_context_statuses"."scope" = 'PUBLIC' and "ranking_context_statuses"."community_id" is null) or ("ranking_context_statuses"."scope" = 'COMMUNITY' and "ranking_context_statuses"."community_id" is not null)

ranking_context_status_reason_valid.name: ranking_context_status_reason_valid
ranking_context_status_reason_valid.value: "ranking_context_statuses"."status" = 'VISIBLE' or ("ranking_context_statuses"."reason" is not null and char_length(btrim("ranking_context_statuses"."reason")) between 5 and 500)
